# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34-35 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_020_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 20

**1** The disciples said to Jesus: "Tell us what the kingdom [тмнтеро] of heaven [мпнуе] is like."

**2** He said to them: "It is like a mustard seed [нвалшнт], the smallest [коуі] of all seeds [сперма].

**3** But when it falls on tilled soil [кахе еушро], it produces [рфт] a large branch [клон нноч] and becomes a shelter [схепе] for the birds of the sky [алате нтпе]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *тмнтеро нмпнуе*: kingdom of heaven; the full phrase — rare in Thomas, which usually says "kingdom of the Father"
- *нвалшнт*: mustard seed; literally "the eye/seed of the šnt-plant"
- *коуі*: small, tiny; "the smallest of seeds"
- *сперма*: Greek loan-word, seed
- *кахе еушро*: "tilled earth" / "cultivated soil" — specific; not just any soil
- *клон нноч*: "large branch" — Thomas says "branch," not "tree" as in Matthew/Luke
- *схепе*: shelter, shade, resting place
- *алате нтпе*: "birds of the sky"
- cf. Matt 13:31-32; Mark 4:30-32; Luke 13:18-19 — the Mustard Seed parable in all three Synoptics
